description: Conformance corpus for the events bus and caller identity. Every runtime runs each case the same way: build the host manifest from `base` overlaid with the case's `host`, create a runtime granting `grants`, run `prelude` and then the case's `script` as host code (no owning mod), load each entry of `mods` in order, then run `steps` in order. Results are compared after a JSON round trip, so `undefined` reads as `null`.
notes: A mod is loaded from the manifest { xript, name, version: '1.0.0', entry: 'main.js' } whose entry source is `trampoline` followed by the mod's own `source`. The trampoline registers one export, `call`, which applies the named global function to the given arguments, so a step can run any function from `script` with that mod as the caller.

Step kinds. `{ as, call, args, expect }`: `as` a mod name invokes that mod's `call` export through the runtime's owned-export invoke; `as: null` runs the function as host code through `execute`. `{ emit, payload?, expect }`: host emit; omit `payload` to emit without one; `expect` is the handler results in order. `{ cancelOwned, expect }`: the runtime's host-side cancel for one owner. `{ declare, expect }` or `{ declare, throws: true }`: the runtime's host-side event declaration.

`callerBindings` names the bindings the harness supplies in caller-aware form (JS/Node `withCaller`, Rust `add_function_with_caller`, C# the `CallerHostFunction` overload). Each one returns `{ modId, binding, args }` built from the call info and the arguments that followed it.
The bus is one JavaScript source every runtime installs verbatim, so error names (`BindingError`, `CapabilityDeniedError`) are part of the contract and the `attempt` helper reports them.

Promise jobs a step queues have run before the next step starts. Rust and Jint run them before a call returns. QuickJS behind `@xriptjs/runtime` runs them only when its host asks, and a Node `vm` context shares the host's microtask queue, so those runners await an `executeAsync` between steps. The `emitAsync` cases record how each promise settled with `track` and read it back in a later step.

Event ids keep the manifest grammar (lowercase letters, digits, '.', '-'); segments are the '.'-separated parts. The only new form is a whole segment written <name>, legal in a `pattern: true` id or an `addressed` form. A <name> matches exactly one segment, so a subject id that itself contains a dot (`stat.hero.hp.changed` against `stat.<instanceId>.changed`) does not match; the `stat.a.b.changed` case pins that.
prelude: function attempt(fn) { try { return fn(); } catch (e) { return { threw: e.name }; } }
trampoline: xript.exports.register('call', function (name, args) { return globalThis[name].apply(null, args || []); });

cases.name: a subscription returns a storable id, its event, and a cancel function
cases.script: function sub() { var a = events.on('tick', function () { return 1; }); var b = events.subscribe('tick', function () { return 2; }); return { idIsString: typeof a.id === 'string', distinct: a.id !== b.id, event: a.event, cancelIsFunction: typeof a.cancel === 'function', frozen: Object.isFrozen(a) }; }

cases.name: handlers run in subscription order across mods and a throwing handler does not stop the rest
cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('tick', function () { return tag; }); return null; } function subThrow() { events.on('tick', function () { throw new Error('boom'); }); return null; }

cases.name: an object payload spreads its values, a scalar is one argument, no payload is none

events.description: Fired after a document is written to disk.

cases.script: function sub() { events.on('document.saved', function () { return Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments); }); return null; }

cases.name: once spends the subscription before its handler runs, so a throwing handler does not resubscribe
cases.script: var saved = {}; var log = []; function subOnce() { saved.h = events.once('tick', function () { log.push('once'); throw new Error('boom'); }); return null; } function state() { return { log: log, count: events.listenerCount('tick'), again: saved.h.cancel() }; }

cases.name: cancel reports cancelled once, then nothing; it takes the id or the subscription object
cases.script: var saved = {}; function sub() { saved.a = events.on('tick', function () { return 'a'; }); saved.b = events.on('tick', function () { return 'b'; }); return null; } function cancelA() { return [events.cancel(saved.a.id), events.cancel(saved.a.id)]; } function cancelB() { return saved.b.cancel(); } function cancelUnknown() { return events.cancel('no-such-subscription'); } function subC() { saved.c = events.on('tick', function () { return 'c'; }); return null; } function cancelByObject() { return events.cancel(saved.c); }

cases.name: cancelling another owner's subscription needs events.off, and unattributed code is not exempt
cases.script: var saved = {}; function sub() { saved.a = events.on('tick', function () { return 'a'; }); return null; } function cancelIt() { return attempt(function () { return events.cancel(saved.a.id); }); }

cases.name: with events.off a mod may cancel another owner's subscription
cases.script: var saved = {}; function sub() { saved.a = events.on('tick', function () { return 'a'; }); return null; } function cancelIt() { return attempt(function () { return events.cancel(saved.a.id); }); }

cases.name: match runs a handler only when every listed payload key is strictly equal

events.description: Fired after a stat's value changes.

cases.script: function sub(match) { events.on('stat.changed', function (stat, value) { return stat + '=' + value; }, { match: match }); return null; } function subBad(options) { return attempt(function () { events.on('stat.changed', function () {}, options); return 'subscribed'; }); } function subFree(match) { events.on('free', function () { return 'free'; }, { match: match }); return null; }

cases.name: off drops only the caller's own listeners without events.off
cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('tick', function () { return tag; }); return null; } function off() { return events.off('tick'); }

cases.name: with events.off a mod's off drops every listener on the event
cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('tick', function () { return tag; }); return null; } function off() { return events.off('tick'); }

cases.name: a mod emits only events declared with emit mods

events.description: Fired when a mod posts a note for the others.

cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('note.posted', function (text) { return tag + ':' + text; }); return null; } function subThrow() { events.on('note.posted', function () { throw new Error('boom'); }); return null; } function post(text) { return attempt(function () { return events.emit('note.posted', { text: text }); }); } function postTick() { return attempt(function () { return events.emit('tick'); }); } function postUnknown() { return attempt(function () { return events.emit('nope'); }); }

cases.name: subscribing to an undeclared event or without the event's capability is refused
cases.script: function subscribe(id) { return attempt(function () { events.on(id, function () { return 'seen'; }); return 'subscribed'; }); } function subBadHandler() { return attempt(function () { events.on('world.changed', 'not a function'); return 'subscribed'; }); }

cases.name: a subsuming grant admits a gated subscription
cases.script: function subscribe(id) { return attempt(function () { events.on(id, function () { return 'seen'; }); return 'subscribed'; }); } function subBadHandler() { return attempt(function () { events.on('world.changed', 'not a function'); return 'subscribed'; }); }

cases.name: cancelOwned clears the caller's own subscriptions and needs events.off to name another owner
cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('tick', function () { return tag; }); return null; } function cancelMine() { return events.cancelOwned(); } function cancelOf(owner) { return attempt(function () { return events.cancelOwned(owner); }); }

cases.name: with events.off cancelOwned may clear another owner
cases.script: function sub(tag) { events.on('tick', function () { return tag; }); return null; } function cancelOf(owner) { return attempt(function () { return events.cancelOwned(owner); }); }

cases.name: claims name namespace owners, longest prefix first, and are never checked at emit

events.description: Fired after one stat instance's value changes.

cases.script: function claim(prefix) { return attempt(function () { return events.claim(prefix); }); } function ns() { return events.namespaces(); } function owner(id) { return events.ownerOf(id); } function sub() { events.on('stat.hero.changed', function () { return 'seen'; }); return null; }

cases.name: claiming needs events.claim
cases.script: function claim(prefix) { return attempt(function () { return events.claim(prefix); }); }

cases.name: a runtime-declared event joins the catalogue and can be subscribed to and emitted
cases.script: function declare(entry) { return attempt(function () { return events.declare(entry); }); } function sub(id, tag) { return attempt(function () { events.on(id, function (x) { return tag + ':' + x; }); return 'subscribed'; }); } function post(id, data) { return attempt(function () { return events.emit(id, data); }); } function describe(id) { return events.describe(id); } function catalogue() { return events.catalogue().map(function (e) { return e.id; }); }

cases.name: names, listenerCount and subscribers report listeners by owner
cases.script: function sub() { events.on('tick', function () {}); return null; } function subSave() { events.on('save', function () {}); return null; } function report() { return { names: events.names(), total: events.listenerCount(), tick: events.listenerCount('tick'), save: events.listenerCount('save'), subscribers: events.subscribers('tick') }; }

cases.name: a dispatch skips a listener cancelled mid-dispatch and does not run one added mid-dispatch
cases.script: var saved = {}; var log = []; function setup() { events.on('tick', function () { log.push('first'); saved.second.cancel(); events.on('tick', function () { log.push('late'); }); }); saved.second = events.on('tick', function () { log.push('second'); }); return null; } function readLog() { return log; }

cases.name: the events global is installed and frozen even when the manifest declares no events
cases.script: function probe() { return { kind: typeof events, frozen: Object.isFrozen(events), verbs: Object.keys(events).sort() }; }

cases.name: a caller-aware binding learns which mod called it

events.description: Fired when the host pings its mods.
Fired by one mod for the others.

cases.script: function who() { return whoami(1, 'two'); } function whoNested() { return probe.whoami(); } function atLoad() { return alphaAtLoad; } function subWho() { events.on('ping', function () { return whoami(); }); events.on('relay', function () { return whoami(); }); return null; } function relay() { var inner = events.emit('relay'); return { inner: inner, after: whoami() }; }

cases.name: emitAsync resolves to exactly the results emit returns, in subscription order

events.description: Fired when a mod posts a note for the others.

cases.script: var settled = {}; function track(key, start) { var entry = { threw: null }; settled[key] = entry; var promise; try { promise = start(); } catch (e) { entry.threw = e.name; return null; } entry.thenable = !!promise && typeof promise.then === 'function'; promise.then(function (r) { entry.resolved = r; }, function (e) { entry.rejected = e.name; }); return null; } function read(key) { return settled[key]; } function sub(tag) { events.on('note.posted', function () { return tag + ':' + Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments).join(','); }); return null; } function subThrow() { events.on('note.posted', function () { throw new Error('boom'); }); return null; } function post(data) { return arguments.length ? events.emit('note.posted', data) : events.emit('note.posted'); } function postAsync(key, data) { var given = arguments.length > 1; return track(key, function () { return given ? events.emitAsync('note.posted', data) : events.emitAsync('note.posted'); }); }

cases.script: var settled = {}; function track(key, start) { var entry = { threw: null }; settled[key] = entry; var promise; try { promise = start(); } catch (e) { entry.threw = e.name; return null; } entry.thenable = !!promise && typeof promise.then === 'function'; promise.then(function (r) { entry.resolved = r; }, function (e) { entry.rejected = e.name; }); return null; } function read(key) { return settled[key]; } function post(id) { return attempt(function () { return events.emit(id, 1); }); } function postAsync(key, id) { return track(key, function () { return events.emitAsync(id, 1); }); }

cases.name: emitAsync delivers as emit does: match, once, a snapshot taken at the start, and each handler run as its owner

events.description: Fired after a stat's value changes.

cases.script: var settled = {}; function track(key, start) { var entry = { threw: null }; settled[key] = entry; var promise; try { promise = start(); } catch (e) { entry.threw = e.name; return null; } entry.thenable = !!promise && typeof promise.then === 'function'; promise.then(function (r) { entry.resolved = r; }, function (e) { entry.rejected = e.name; }); return null; } function read(key) { return settled[key]; } var saved = {}; function subHp() { events.on('stat.changed', function (stat, value) { return whoami().modId + ':' + stat + '=' + value; }, { match: { stat: 'hp' } }); return null; } function subOnce() { events.once('stat.changed', function (stat) { return 'once:' + stat; }); return null; } function subMeddler() { events.on('stat.changed', function () { if (saved.late) saved.late.cancel(); events.on('stat.changed', function () { return 'added'; }); return 'meddler'; }); return null; } function subLate() { saved.late = events.on('stat.changed', function () { return 'late'; }); return null; } function postAsync(key, stat, value) { return track(key, function () { return events.emitAsync('stat.changed', { stat: stat, value: value }); }); } function after() { return whoami().modId; }
